title: How to handle the flaky payment-form test
ask: Quarantine the flaky test now, or hold the release until it is fixed?

options.label: Quarantine and file a fix row
options.consequence: Release proceeds today; a P2 ledger row tracks the fix. Test is skipped until fixed.

options.label: Hold the release
options.consequence: No release until the test is fixed; about one day of delay.

recommendation_reason: Failure rate is 4% and unrelated to this release; quarantine is human-gated and tracked.
